title: sync-packageset-kernel: fix selection criteria and --package-set option
commit_message:
sync-packageset-kernel: fix selection criteria and --package-set option

A couple of small fixes:

1) fix the primary selection criteria so it correctly selects development
   mode kernels, and
2) switch us to the more common --packageset option (compatibilty is
   maintained).
diff:
diff --git a/sync-packageset-kernel b/sync-packageset-kernel
index caedffc..aff5395 100755
--- a/sync-packageset-kernel
+++ b/sync-packageset-kernel
@@ -65,7 +65,7 @@ class UpdatePackageSet:
         ks = KernelSeries()
         ks_series = ks.lookup_series(codename=self.series.name)
         for ks_source in ks_series.sources:
-            if ks_source.supported or not ks_source.development:
+            if ks_source.supported or ks_source.development:
                 for ks_package in ks_source.packages:
                     newSet.add(ks_package.name)
 
@@ -93,7 +93,7 @@ if __name__ == '__main__':
 
     parser = ArgumentParser()
     parser.add_argument("--series", help="series-name to update.")
-    parser.add_argument("--package-set", help="package-set name to update.", default="kernel")
+    parser.add_argument("--packageset", "--package-set", help="package-set name to update.", default="kernel")
     parser.add_argument("-y", "--yes", help="perform the update", action="store_true")
     args = parser.parse_args()
 
@@ -101,5 +101,5 @@ if __name__ == '__main__':
         print("ERROR: --series is required.", file=sys.stderr)
         sys.exit(1)
 
-    update_package_set = UpdatePackageSet(args.series, args.package_set)
+    update_package_set = UpdatePackageSet(args.series, args.packageset)
     update_package_set.update_sources(dry_run=not args.yes)
